description: This file defines custom Cypress command functions for testing purposes, including setting up API mocks, login procedures, and data seeding for a dashboard web app.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Adds intercepts to mock API endpoints for login, users, reports, and charts for testing.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Simulates user login via UI form interactions and waits for login API response.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Sets a fake JWT token directly into local storage to simulate authenticated state.
